notes.title: New Build Version: July 22, 2021
notes.notes:
​New public build is up!  Most changes are behind the scenes bug fixes. The main changes are:

- Keys can now be rebound
- Adjustable flying and digging speed in Creative Mode options
- Transparent materials and object support (glass)​​​
- Better torch attachment
- Player and object going through thin walls fix
- Physics smoothing on high frame-rate displays
- Drops don't fly away too much anymore
- Reworked how tool power works
- UI icons higher resolution
- Fixed reflection banding
- Fixed cloud banding in the distance

Have fun!

- Nel

notes.title: June 04, 2021 Update!
notes.notes:
The main changes are:
- Lots of new brushes: cubes, spheres, copy pasta, blockify, smoothing and many more.
- New settings, including in-game settings.
- Create multiple universes.
A lot of keybinds have changed, so you it might take some time to get used to.

Have fun!
- Nel
